purpose: Give alien C and his obvious disguise variant angry, downturned frowns while retaining a somewhat cute comic expression. Concept reference only.

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: low-poly alien character concept sheet, two versions of the same character.
Input image: edit target. The left figure is the lanky blue-gray alien in an asymmetric mustard-and-charcoal tunic; the right figure is the exact same alien wearing a small brown hat, glasses, taped-on black eyebrows and an obvious fake moustache.
Primary request: make BOTH versions visibly angry and frowning, but still somewhat cute and funny. The current mouth reads as a smile; replace it with an unmistakable closed downturned frown, with the center of the mouth higher than both corners. This must clearly read as a small grumpy pout, never a smile or smirk. Draw the downturned mouth as a clean dark curved line with the corners pointing down.
Facial edit: lower and angle the inner ends of the brows toward the nose for an annoyed scowl, keeping the outer ends higher. Add a small soft crease between them and gently narrow the eyes, but keep the eyes rounded and visibly expressive with clear pupils. Add just a subtle amount of lower-cheek fullness to soften the expression, keeping the alien's face recognizable. He should look like a mildly furious, endearingly grumpy cartoon neighbor. No teeth or snarling, no deep angry wrinkles or scary shadows, no threatening gaze. Do not turn him into a baby or chibi mascot.
For the right disguised version: angle the fake stick-on eyebrows into a comically angry V while keeping their obvious adhesive tabs. Keep the moustache intact, but let the plainly downturned lower mouth and small pout remain visible immediately below it, so the frown is legible even through the disguise. Keep the costume spectacles with clear lenses, hat, moustache and all tape.
Preserve everything else: character identity, blue-gray skin, wide elongated faceted cranium, angular long nose and narrow chin, lanky adult proportions, long neck and limbs, upright relaxed standing pose, arms down, hands and feet positions, mustard-and-charcoal alien outfit, geometric clasp, cuffs, hip device and boots; both full-body views, spacing, framing, pale gray backdrop, soft shadows, matte flat-shaded low-poly style and lighting. Change only the facial expressions and the very subtle cheek softness needed to retain comic appeal. No new props, no text, no crop, no logos or watermark.
